title: Native reservation Gear on system chrome
lede: Gear search, category, cart, and conflicts now use searchable, toolbar, swipe, and badge APIs instead of a handmade field, chip bar, and cart inset.

sections.heading: After-only fixture evidence
sections.note: iPhone 16 Pro (27.0) UDID E055DEBC-12B1-4E0F-BE11-1CFFF4A454DE, WisconsinPerformance create-booking-events, light appearance. Bottom toolbar is empty-state hidden until an item is selected. The 6:30 AM device screenshot is live inventory in dark mode, so it is not a matched before pair.

shots.title: Gear browse
shots.cap: System search sits in the navigation drawer. Category is a trailing toolbar menu next to Scan. LENS-032 keeps a red alert in the add slot. Addable pluses stay gray, including needed-next rows.

changes.was: A handmade TextField in a top inset, with .toolbar(removing: .search) to suppress iOS 27’s bottom search accessory.
changes.now: .searchable in the navigation bar drawer, with .searchFocused so search-select-search can keep the keyboard after an add.

changes.was: All/Cameras/Lenses/Batteries/Other lived in the search field. Selected gear was a custom bottom bar.
changes.now: Category is a trailing toolbar menu beside Scan. Selected count and Review are ToolbarItem(placement: .bottomBar) and appear after the first add.

changes.was: Custom plus/Unavailable chrome, no swipe, no item peek.
changes.now: Swipe Add/Remove, long-press View item, and a red alert in the add slot for conflicts. The plus stays gray on every addable row.

verification: vitest ios-create-booking-picker-parity and ios-native-control-cleanup passed (25 tests in the later rerun; 28 including identity).
WisconsinPerformance CreateBookingEventPickerScreenshotUITests/testEventPickerCaptures passed and captured Gear with Unavailable visible.
git diff --check passed on the touched composer, test, and area-doc files.
notes: The empty cart does not mount the bottom toolbar, by design.
iOS 27 groups the filter, Scan, and minimize controls into one trailing cluster.
Authenticated physical dark-mode proof remains open.
